description.value: Cantonese BBQ Seafood Restaurant is an authentic Cantonese eatery on Kingsway in east Vancouver, specializing in BBQ meats alongside an extensive menu of noodle dishes, fried rice, and seafood. It is part of a small two-location chain (Vancouver and Richmond) and offers online ordering with in-store pickup. Touring cyclists passing through the Kingsway corridor will find a wide-ranging lunch and dinner menu covering everything from quick single-item BBQ-over-rice plates to large combination banquet sets.

OSM `takeaway=yes` is confirmed by the website's 'Order Now Pickup 15 min' prompt; the menu lists 'Buddha's Feast Chow Mein 羅漢齋炒麵' (a traditional Buddhist vegetarian dish), providing positive evidence for vegetarian options. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the OSM tags or website content, so all three required criteria remain null.
